scenes.sub: Must be Serializable. Sent as a COPY. Changes on the server do not affect the client’s object.
Sent as a STUB (reference). Calls go back to the original object.

answer_html:
Definition

Parameters and return values of remote methods are sent across the network by marshalling. How they are passed depends on their type.

Points

  • Return values follow the same rules.
  • Object classes must be available on both sides (or downloadable).
TypeHow passedNote
Primitive (int, double…)By valueCopy
Serializable object (String, ArrayList, own class)By value (serialized copy)Changes on one side not seen by the other
Remote objectBy reference (stub)Calls go to the original object
NeitherCannot be passedThrows MarshalException
